subject: Security form launch: ops alignment + data sovereignty questions
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@wellcore.ai>; Amit Shah <amit.shah@wellcore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: security form launch, hosting & residency clarifications

Hi Marta / Amit —

Great to speak earlier. Per our demo and the procurement checklist, I wanted to capture the security intake items we discussed and a short list of clarifying questions so your team can pick the right form (SIG/CAIQ/custom) and hosting option. Attached is a quick prefill worksheet (WellCore_SIG_Prefill.xlsx) with the items we captured live — please fill or mark N/A where applicable.

Quick recap and asks:
- Suggested form: SIG baseline (we can prefill) unless you require an extended CAIQ or a custom matrix for PHI.
- Primary hosting options: Redwood-hosted (multi-tenant US) vs Dedicated (reserved GPUs in AWS us-west-2) vs Private VPC. Please confirm residency preference.
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II in scope for our inference platform; if you need the certificate, let me know who in procurement should receive it.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports BAA for HIPAA scopes (we have an ops playbook and audit traces). If PHI ingestion is planned, say so now so we can route you to Private or Dedicated options.
- KMS / key control: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) on Dedicated/Private.

Requested next steps (can we align on these by EOD Thursday?):
1) You mark the attached prefill with any required hosting/residency choices and PHI flag.
2) Tell us whether you want SIG (fastest), CAIQ (more detailed), or a custom form.
3) If SIG, who should we list as recipients for the SOC 2 and encryption evidence?

Attachments referenced:
- WellCore_SIG_Prefill.xlsx (prefill workbook)
- redwood-network-diagram.pdf (simple hosting diagram)

If helpful, Ben and Neha (cc) can jump on a 20-minute follow-up to confirm answers and ownership.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@wellcore.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@wellcore.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security form launch, hosting & residency clarifications

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap and the worksheet — that helps. A few quick clarifications from our side before we pull in procurement: 

1) PHI: We will likely send pseudonymized PHI to the model in production for one narrow workflow. That implies we need either a BAA + Dedicated or Private deployment. Can you confirm whether the Dedicated option supports customer-managed keys with Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and whether audit logs for host-level access are included?

2) SOC 2 evidence: Procurement wants the Type II report and also a short attestation that the inference runtime is covered by the report (they sometimes get nervous about third-party runtime components). Can Redwood provide a short cover letter (1 page) stating scope?

3) SIG vs CAIQ: we prefer SIG for speed, but we may need a CAIQ subset on data residency and encryption for our legal team. If you can prefill the SIG and also indicate which CAIQ questions we’d need to expand on, that would be ideal.

We’ll start filling the prefill and aim to return it by Thursday. If procurement has specific DocuSign or vendor intake forms, we’ll attach them.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Product Ops | WellCore Health
marta@wellcore.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@wellcore.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 12:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security form launch, hosting & residency clarifications

Marta —

Quick answers to the questions you raised: 
- Dedicated & BYOK: yes — Dedicated pools can be configured with customer-managed AWS KMS keys (we documented the flow in the attached diagram). Key material never leaves your KMS; we integrate via key policy and envelope encryption.
- Audit logs: we provide audit logs for control-plane actions (deployments, key rotations) and runtime access traces. For Private deployments we can also enable host-level telemetry collection and ship via your log collector (SPLUNK/Datadog) under a support engagement.
- SOC 2 scope cover letter: absolutely — we’ll produce a 1-page scope letter signed by our compliance lead that explicitly calls out the inference runtime and public API endpoints. I’ll kick that to you once Legal signs off.

To make the SIG/CAIQ decision simpler I propose: Jasmine prefill the SIG, we mark the 8 CAIQ questions that typically expand on residency/encryption/third-party dependencies, and label those as ‘optional follow-up’. That way procurement can get the SIG now and the CAIQ subset later if needed.

I’ll update the prefill with the CAIQ markers and drop a short cover letter draft into the Drive link referenced.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0147
